issues.detail: The Hebrew 'יְהוָה' (YHWH) is the divine name, used as a vocative or subject, not as the object of '尋求' (seek). The Chinese renders '尋求你的耶和華' ('YHWH who seeks you'), reversing the relationship: in Hebrew, it is the seekers who seek YHWH, not YHWH who seeks them. This changes who is doing what to whom.
